in_marathi.name: Ritansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ritansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ritansh is a Sanskrit name meaning 'sun's essence'. It name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rit' meaning 'sun' and 'ansh' meaning 'essence'. This name is believed to represent the power and strength of the sun and the wisdom it brings.
